## Problem and result

Link the ticket. State the observed problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

Record the failing test before the fix, affected passing tests, and related mutant results. Identify source and tools. Documentation-only changes can explain why behavior tests do not apply.

## Evidence and review

Preserve original failures and missing observations. Record separate Standards and Spec reviews. State effects on coverage, recovery, permissions, imports, and frozen reports. Keep full mutation paused.
